main_text.p: munis est, & qui infra illam deprimitur ad contemptum, & qui supra illam erigitur ad dignitatem. Proinde si expandas Virtutis alas, & uno nisu in altum evoles, jam ultra Invidiæ fines penetraveris, antequam ad carpendum, dentes & morsum figere potuerit: Si vero dissimules, & in altum repas, & subinde à regia via declines, ne quo cautè tendis, ire videaris, ætatem teres & ingenium miseris consiliis: fruftra inter dejectam plebem, Virtutem & Gloriam ex longinquo suspiciens.Quid quod sensim suffocetur Animus, in his tegnarum latibulis compressus & intortus? cui Natura infeverat igneum quiddam & amplum & angustiarum dedignans: Quid quod sensim in vitium degeneret? page.notes: Show-through from the facing page is visible at the right edge and at the foot ("muoi"-like smudge) and was not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "fruftra" and "fenfim"/"fensim" are as printed; "dejectam" printed with ligature. Last word "fervi-" is a line-end hyphenated word continuing on the next page.
